title: कम बोलने वाला leader
subtitle: Bina room par chhaye, logon ko direction, safety aur ownership dene ki practice
credit: Yeh quiet leadership, community organizing, trust-building aur ethical influence ke principles se inspired independent Hinglish adaptation hai.
sources: Research traditions: psychological safety, procedural justice, shared leadership aur group decision-making. Saare characters aur scenes fictional hain. Yeh ideas practical lenses hain, har workplace ya power imbalance ka complete solution nahi.
